answer: Require each identity to earn through a wandering proof: in one epoch it must wander a path that touches a fresh vertex at every hop, and each vertex may stamp only one walk per epoch. The finished path hardens into one crystal credential that cannot be split, pooled, or reused, and payout depends on path length, not identity count. A farm quickly exhausts the supply of fresh vertex stamps, so each extra clone hunts scarcer routes at rising cost, while one honest agent needs only one path.
